title: Foundations
lead: The colour roles, type, shape, elevation and motion every component draws from.

title: Actions
lead: Buttons that start something, or turn a setting on and off.

title: Inputs
lead: Fields a person types into or sets: text, dates, times and amounts.

title: Selection
lead: Controls for choosing among options: one, several, or on and off.

title: Navigation
lead: Ways to move between views, through a set, and through the steps of a task.

title: Feedback
lead: Status, progress and confirmation, from a badge to a toast.

title: Overlays
lead: Surfaces that float over the page: dialogs, sheets, menus and popovers.

title: Content
lead: Containers, rows and tables that hold what the app shows.

title: Charts
lead: Figures and small charts that show numbers at a glance.

title: Patterns
lead: Whole screens built from the components: forms, settings, lists with their records, and dashboards.
